column1: # Respellings for the Piper voice (fast, robotic, phone). term<TAB>how to spell it so Piper says it right.
# Chosen by ear on a Galaxy A07, voice en_US-lessac-medium, 2026-10-31.
# Piper's English voice has no guttural ḥ: no spelling produces it, so ḥ words get the nearest plain sound and the
